realistic.label: 写实还原
realistic.prompt: Preserve the reference character's facial structure, body proportions, clothing, materials, lighting cues, and recognizable visual identity with highly faithful semi-realistic rendering.

3d.label: 3D 卡通风
3d.prompt: Use polished 3D cartoon rendering with expressive facial animation, smooth materials, controlled proportions, soft studio lighting, subtle ambient occlusion, and a clean sticker finish.

hand-drawn.label: 手绘风
hand-drawn.prompt: Use warm hand-drawn illustration, clean expressive linework, softly textured color, visible brush character, and friendly sticker-like shapes while preserving the reference IP.

chibi.label: Q版
chibi.prompt: Use an expressive chibi style with an oversized head, compact body, clear facial reactions, rounded cute shapes, and consistent simplified details.

manga.label: 漫画风
manga.prompt: Use dynamic manga-inspired illustration with expressive eyes, confident ink contours, selective cel shading, energetic gesture language, and clear sticker silhouettes.

pixel-art.label: 像素艺术
pixel-art.prompt: Use carefully designed pixel art with a consistent limited palette, readable silhouettes, deliberate pixel clusters, expressive animation-ready poses, and crisp edges.

cute.label: 可爱风
cute.prompt: Use a warm cute character style with soft rounded shapes, appealing expressions, gentle color accents, charming gesture language, and polished sticker readability.

retro.label: 复古风
retro.prompt: Use a retro-inspired illustration treatment with period-evocative color separation, tactile print texture, bold simplified shapes, and nostalgic sticker finishing.
